sources.title: inclusionAI/LBS-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LBS-27B is an agentic vision-language model based on Qwen3.8-27b. It learns to select and inspect image regions through GUI grounding, then transfers this observation policy to general-domain visual question answering and high-resolution perception ...

sources.title: Architecture graph for inclusionAI/LBS-27B. - hfviewer
sources.snippet: inclusionAI/LBS-27B architecture at a glance inclusionAI/LBS-27B is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5 architecture). Its backbone uses 64 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,120, and a hybrid layer schedule of 48 linear-attention and 16 full-attention layers (full attention every 4th layer).
